title: Joust
shortDescription: Joust anchors a Nintendo Entertainment System platformer catalog entry in GameAtlas, with a deterministic note and a linked structured-data source.
highlights: Frames a platformer catalog entry for source-aware Nintendo Entertainment System exploration.
Keeps third-party commentary and scores out of the linked metadata path.
